title: State Department UAP Cable 4, Ashgabat, Turkmenistan, November 5, 2004
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable from the U.S. Embassy in Ashgabat, Turkmenistan, discussing the activities of a local NGO called the Union of Ufologists; it explicitly states that despite the organization's name, there have been no confirmed sightings of UFOs in Turkmenistan.
